author: LifaR

title: Awesome app however, it lacks some features
body: The app is very good and it helps me a lot, but I believe that it lacks a lot of options for frequency settings. If I am trying to break a habit, I can not set what I would like to do once a week for example - I have to set up specific days that it will be allowed. I am also waiting for the ability to add habits I do more than once a day as one habit, instead of having to set each time separately.
